βίας: βία — force, violence; fem. acc. pl.: ‘acts of violence’ · also ’strength, force’ (ὑμέων βίας ’your strength’)
βορέαο: Βορέης — Boreas, the North Wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Βορέου)
βόας: βοῦς — ox, cow, head of cattle; acc. pl. βόας (= Attic βοῦς)
γενέσθην: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐγενέσθην): ’the two became, grew to be’
δίε: δείδω (poet. δίω) — fear; past 3 sg. (aor. or impf.), epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἔδεισε): ’feared’; with περί ’greatly’ and μή ’lest’
δαμείη: δάμνημι (= δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue, overcome; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg.
δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
διοκλῆος: Διοκλῆς — Diocles, host of Telemachus at Pherae; masc. gen. sg.
δούρατ: δόρυ — beam, timber, plank; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic δούρατα, elided (δούρατ’ = δούρατα) · also neut. acc. pl., ’spears’ (δούρατ’ ἀλεύαντο ’avoided the spears’)
δυνήσατο: δύναμαι — be able, can; aor. 3 sg. (deponent), unaugmented (= ἐδυνήσατο)
εἶπέ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., accented εἶπέ before a following enclitic (τε)
εὐεργέος: εὐεργής — well-wrought, well-made; masc./neut. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic εὐεργοῦς)
εὔπωλον: εὔπωλος — rich in foals, of fine horses; fem. acc. sg. (two-ending adj.), epithet of Ilios
κατέκταθεν: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. pass. 3 pl., root aorist in -θεν, augmented (κατ’ + ἔκταθεν; unaugmented κτάθεν elsewhere in Homer): ’were slain’
κατέκτανεν: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg. act. (strong aor. -έκτανον), ν-movable (Attic κατέκτεινεν): ’killed’
λεύκ: λευκός — white; neut. nom. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά) · also neut. acc. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά), agreeing with ὀστέα: ’white’
λὰξ: λάξ — with the foot, by kicking; adv.
μένον: μένω — wait, wait for; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented · also impf. 1 sg. (same form), intransitive: ’I remained, stayed’
μένοντε: μένω — stay, wait, stand firm; pres. part. masc. nom. dual: ’the two waiting’ · also masc. acc. dual (same form), agreeing with the unspoken subject of an infinitive: ’we two staying’ (νῶϊν … μένοντε)
μεγάθυμον: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. acc. sg.
μεῖνε: μένω — remain, stay; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμεινε): ’remained’
νέφεα: νέφος — cloud; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νέφη)
ναῖε: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, live; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔναιε): ’was dwelling, used to live’
νεκροῦ: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. gen. sg.
πάθοι: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to suffer’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in an indirect question in past sequence: ’what he had suffered’
πέσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσον): ’I fell’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (same form): ’they fell’
παλάμῃσι: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
πλέονες: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλέων/πλείων, masc. nom. pl. πλέονες: ’the greater number, most’
πολλοί: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πότνι: πότνια — lady, mistress; title of respect for goddesses; fem. nom. sg. (elided πότνι’)
φοίτα: φοιτάω — go to and fro, range about; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφοίτα)
ἀκροπόλοισιν: ἀκρόπολος — high-peaked, lofty; dat. pl. in -οισιν, the same in all genders (= Attic -οις), of mountains
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄνδρεσσιν: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
ἐλάτῃσιν: ἐλάτη — fir; fir-wood oar; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), instrumental
ἐλέησεν: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg.
ἐλέφαντι: ἐλέφας — ivory, elephant; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with ivory’
ἐπείγετο: ἐπείγω — press, drive on; pass./mid. hasten, be driven; impf. 3 sg. pass.: ’was driven on, was urged on’
ἐφέστασαν: ἐφίστημι — set upon; intrans. stand over, take one’s stand; aor. 3 pl., epic -στασαν (= Attic ἐπέστησαν)
ἐϋκτιμένῃ: ἐΰκτιμένος — well-built, well-founded; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐ-), of Lesbos
ἐόντε: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. dual, epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν): ’being’, with περ ’though they were’
ἑλέτην: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic εἱλέτην): ’the two seized’
ἔγχε: ἔγχος — spear; neut. nom. pl., elided uncontracted (ἔγχε’ = ἔγχεα)
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily, without a break’ · also neut. nom. sg., adj. agreeing with μένος: ’firm’
ἔρυσαν: ἐρύω (εἰρύω) — draw, drag, haul; aor. 3 pl., epic: ’hauled up’
ἔστησεν: ἵστημι — set, place, stand (trans.); aor. 1 3 sg.
ἔτικτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’begot’
ἔχουσα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕταρον: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἤλασ: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἤλασ’ = ἤλασε)
ἰών: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἴφια: ἴφιος — stout, sturdy (the traditional gloss; ’fat’ also given); neut. acc. pl., with μῆλα
ὀξυόεντα: ὀξυόεις — sharp, pointed; neut. acc. pl., epic -εντα (ὀξύς ’sharp’)
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, from behind; adv. · also ’hereafter, afterwards’ (of time)
ὄρεσσιν: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
ὄρνυται: ὄρνυμαι — be stirred, be roused; pres. 3 sg.
ὄτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, send speedily; aor. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl. (same -ον ending), unaugmented
ὕλης: ὕλη — wood, forest, thicket; fem. gen. sg.
ὤμοιιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual gen., epic (= Attic ὤμοιν): ’from the shoulders’ · also dual dat.: ’on the shoulders’ (ὤμοιιν βαλόμην ’I slung on my shoulders’)
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’arose’ (of a wind springing up) · also of a person: ’set out, started’ (ὦρτο πόλινδ’ ἴμεν ’set out to go to the city’) · also of a person rising: ’rose, got up’ (ὦρτο δ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς εὐνῆς ἐκ μαλακῆς ’Odysseus rose from the soft couch’)
